items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: listening to Charlie Parker, Coltrane. Even one bar, write it down. ... Those were my favorite.

ctx.x: On Coltrane I heard he used to play at hotels, and I tell a couple of students, just fingering for an hour before 9:00 or whatever. So I say this is a real test because you can’t cheat yourself. If you play a C sharp major scale, or any scale [scats] really fast, you can just think of “Jada” and play it on your horn and some notes come out quicker than the others, so it really focuses you. It’s a great thing. I only did it once or twice. The other thing I wanted to say about growing up, the influence, besides…
You had about two channels, right?
